about_the_game:
Defracted - is an online 3rd person arena shooter. The world is set in a fictional sci-fi realm where 2 teams are at war with each other over prosperity in a virtual reality game created by an alien civilization. In this game, you can come together with friends or random online players to battle each other in various game modes. Customize your player and their loadout to deploy on the battlefield. Level up and become the strongest of the pack.

KEY FEATURES

  • Online PVP (2-8 players)

  • Leveling System

  • Character Selection

  • Weapon Customization

  • Multiple Game modes (secure the bag, elimination, TDM, FFA, demolition)

  • Multiple Maps with Nighttime mode

  • Online Shop System

  • Daily Login Rewards!

Story Plot - It was the year 2150, and the world had become a desolate and dangerous place. The last remaining humans had retreated to a virtual reality game. In this game, there were two factions: the Guardians and the Renegades.

The Guardians were a noble and just team, led by a brave warrior named Aria. They fought to protect the innocent and uphold justice in the virtual world. On the other hand, the Renegades were a ruthless and chaotic team, led by a cunning strategist named Xander. They craved power and were willing to do whatever it took to achieve it.

For years, these two teams coexisted in the game, each controlling their own territories and battling for dominance. However, tensions rose as resources became scarce and territories were contested. The once friendly banter between the teams turned into heated arguments and eventually, all-out war.

As the war raged on, both sides suffered losses. Many warriors from both teams were killed, while others were left injured and scarred. The Guardians, with Aria at the helm, remained determined to protect the innocents and bring peace to the virtual world. Meanwhile, the Renegades, fueled by their thirst for power, grew more and more ruthless.

However, amidst all the chaos and destruction, something unexpected happened. A small group of Guardians and Renegades stumbled upon an ancient temple hidden deep within the planet. Inside, they found a holographic projection of a wise being, who revealed the true purpose of the game.

The virtual world was created by an advanced alien civilization, who wanted to test the humans' ability to work together and their determination to create a better world. The Guardians and Renegades were chosen to represent the best and worst of humanity, and the true goal of the game was to find a way to unite and coexist peacefully.

Feeling a sense of shame and guilt for their actions, the Guardians and Renegades agreed to put an end to the war and work towards peace. With their newfound understanding and respect for each other, the two teams joined forces to explore the rest of the planet and uncover its mysteries.

Years went by, and the virtual world transformed into a utopia where all beings lived in harmony. Aria and Xander, once bitter enemies, became close allies and friends. And although they were still fighting in the game, it was now for the greater good of their virtual home.

The two teams had finally achieved the impossible – a world where even in the midst of war, peace and unity prevailed. And as they continued to explore the endless possibilities of the virtual world, they knew that they were unstoppable, even in the face of unknown challenges.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or greater
  • Processor: i5-2500 3.30 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2.5 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 or AMD Radeon Radeon RX 560 & above
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Plays on most systems.
